scenes.say: Ever wondered if you should use labels or numbers to access your data in pandas? Let's break down how indexing really works.

scenes.label: Series
scenes.sub: A Series is a one-dimensional labeled array.
scenes.say: First up, a Series is just a single column of data, but with labels for every entry.
A DataFrame is like a table with rows and columns, each with their own labels. Series is one column, DataFrame is the whole table.
Use loc with row and column names for label-based access. Use iloc with numbers for position-based access.

scenes.question: What happens if you mix up loc and iloc?
scenes.wrong: It works the same either way.
scenes.right: Mixing them up can cause errors or wrong data. Always match the method to the type of index.
scenes.say: Don't mix up loc and iloc. Using the wrong one can give you errors or unexpected results.
